correctness.rationale: Proof checks the support and bond-normal normalization, Laplacian eigenvalues, the inequality 2(N-2)>N²/(N-1) for N>=6, exact N=4,5 cases, and the complete optimal-center halfspace constraints. A counterexample to the uniqueness part would require a center outside the proven tight-normal affine locus or an omitted facet; the proof excludes both. Exact-square tests and high-precision interval checks corroborate but are not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: This is a natural exact intrinsic insphere classification of a basic two-parameter family of graph-root zonotopes: a closed radius, a sharp four-cycle switch between nonsingleton and singleton tangent cuts, and a nontrivial uniqueness versus (p-1)-dimensional center-locus phenomenon, with complete interval geometry for p=2. It is not merely the generic cut formula or a textbook exercise; spectral separation handles infinitely many competing cuts, while equality normals determine all centers. The data are useful for geometric centers, radius estimates and comparison with the known enclosing-ellipsoid geometry. The additional exact center-set geometry supports mathematical interest independent of numerical verification.
